# Rock OS
> A 64-bit operating system built from scratch in C++ and x86 assembly by AyoubCh9807.

## Overview
Rock OS is a hobby 64-bit operating system featuring GOP framebuffer graphics, custom window manager, keyboard & mouse drivers, shell environment, physical frame allocation, and 4-level paging.

## GitHub Repository
- Repository: https://github.com/AyoubCh9807/RockOS
- Developer: https://github.com/AyoubCh9807

## Important Architecture Notes
- Processes, context switching, and process isolation are mostly implemented in kernel infrastructure, but not currently tested or used by the desktop environment.
- Native applications include Bouncing DVD app, Matrix code rain app, Rock AI preview app, and Paint app (currently broken / under refactoring).
- System calls (syscalls) are not implemented yet.
